name: Agnes Boulange
original_name: アニエス・ブーランジュ
source: Agnes is the self-proclaimed World's Best Doll Maker. Talented artificer specialized in automatas; her masterpiece is Tango, a cat-shaped automata which can talk. She is an apprentice of [url=/c9060]Mise Altoise[/url]. Agnes was born in Print'brise, which explains her love for sweets. Agnes is also energetic and the group's moodmaker. She also works as a street performer with her automatas in the Ert'Aria's main plaza.
